question: In which of the following Indian states is the M.A. Chidambaram Stadium located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The M.A. Chidambaram Stadium is located in Chennai, the capital city of the state of Tamil Nadu in India.
 
• It is one of the oldest cricket stadiums in India, with a rich history dating back to its establishment in 1916.
 
• The stadium is famously known as the Chepauk Stadium by the local populace, owing to its location in the Chepauk area of Chennai.
 
• It has been the home ground for the Tamil Nadu cricket team in domestic competitions and the Chennai Super Kings franchise in the Indian Premier League (IPL).
 
• The stadium is owned and operated by the Tamil Nadu Cricket Association (TNCA).
 
• Over the decades, the M.A. Chidambaram Stadium has witnessed numerous iconic moments in Indian cricket history.
 
• It has hosted several significant international matches, including Test matches, One Day Internationals (ODIs), and Twenty20 Internationals (T20Is).
 
• The stadium was one of the venues for the Cricket World Cups held in 1987, 1996, and 2011.
 
• The atmosphere at Chepauk is renowned for its passionate and knowledgeable cricket fans, who are known for their enthusiastic support of the game.
 
• The stadium has undergone several renovations and expansions over the years to enhance its facilities and seating capacity.
